name: Exotic Pets
oracle_text: Create two 1/1 blue Fish creature tokens with "This token can't be blocked." Then for each kind of counter among creatures you control, put a counter of that kind on either of those tokens.
blocked_sentences: Create two 1/1 blue Fish creature tokens with "This token can't be blocked."
Then for each kind of counter among creatures you control, put a counter of that kind on either of those tokens.

needs.what: a 1/1 blue Fish creature token with "This token can't be blocked."
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has only fish_1_1_u, a plain 1/1 blue Fish with no evasion; substituting it would drop the unblockable clause

needs.what: an op that collects the distinct counter kinds among a selector's objects (creatures you control, including the just-created tokens) and, for each kind, puts one counter of that kind on a chosen one of a bound set of objects (the two tokens created via create_token `as`)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_counters takes one fixed `counter` kind; move_counters/remove_counters have any_kind/all_kinds but move or remove existing counters rather than adding a fresh one per distinct kind; proliferate adds to permanents that already have counters, not to a chosen token; no value or for_each iterates over counter kinds
